Name: Yet another dog mod
Author: spacesheepcaptain
Description:
[right][size=3][/size][/right][center][color=#8e7cc3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2068][img]https://i.imgur.com/USOlcoV.png[/img][/url] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18802][img]https://i.imgur.com/w4N3ESe.png[/img][/url]﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4258][img]https://i.imgur.com/CAi81sa.png[/img][/url]﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25142][img]https://i.imgur.com/o5eKPQe.png[/img][/url]
 ★ ★ ★[/color][/center]
[right][color=#dbb0a7]I already have those sprites on the [url=https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/yet-another-dog-mod-pomeranian%E2%AD%90bull-terrier%E2%AD%90more.137293/]OFFICIAL FORUM[/url]﻿, but disaded to add them here too :)[/color][/right]
[size=3]
[font=Georgia][color=#9999ff][i]Hiya~★
i drew some doggos for fun and thought - hey! i may as well share it
they're not perfect (blame my hands about pomeranian tail, what looks like alien jellyfish who want to eat his butt), but still, maybe someone will find them cute[/i][/color]
[b]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6semRXO.gif[/img][/b][/font][font=Georgia]
[color=#cc99ff][b]installation (Content Patcher - vanilla replacer):[/b][/color][b] [/b]it changes all 5 dogs to new breeds! first of all, make sure you have installed [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][b]Content Patcher[/b][/url] and everything it requires! drop my mod folder into your "***\Stardew Valley\Mods\". you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/url] ingame to choose the rest (which breed and variation to which type of dog).
[color=#cc99ff][b]installation (Content Patcher - standalone):[/b] [/color][color=#f4f4f4]instead of changing vanilla dogs it adds additional breeds which you can buy from Marnie! it does have the same requirements as the above AND [b][u]you can use both at the same time[/u][/b] (replacer and standalone)
[color=#cc99ff][b]installation (Alternative Textures):[/b] [/color][color=#f4f4f4]drop the files into "Mods" folder and don't forget that you need the main [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] mod! the rest is explained on AT's page.
[/color][/color][/font][/size][size=3][font=Georgia][b][color=#999999][s]installation (xnb):[/s][/color][/b][color=#999999][s] put your file of choice into Content\Animals and replace the "dog.xnb", "dog1.xnb" or/and "dog2.xnb" with it. this way you can have up to 3 different dogs at once! [/s][i][s](patch 1.4+)[/s] [b]if someone (for some reason) will need .xnb files again - i might reapload them, but for now they're no longer available to download.[/b][/i][/color]

[/font][right][font=Georgia][color=#9999ff]p.s: sorry, if i write with mistakes - not very confident with my english skills
p.s.s: if you'll notice that something is wrong with the mod - please, let me know﻿﻿
[/color][/font][img]https://i.imgur.com/6semRXO.gif[/img]﻿[/right][/size][size=1][b][i][u][url='https://www.deviantart.com/gasara/art/Animated-Rainbow-Heart-Divider-331662041'][right]border[/right][/url][/u][/i][/b][/size]
